name: Tousle
author: E. T. Carter
description: A full-frame field of fine threads combed roughly level but interweaving: each thread wanders by close to a whole row-spacing so neighbours cross and tousle into a dense luminous hank that fills the frame edge to edge. Light runs along the strands and the whole combed field drifts on a slow diagonal. Open crossing strands, never closed cells.

params.label: Threads
params.effect: How many rows of thread fill the frame — a few bold combed strands at the low end, a dense fine hank at the high end.

params.label: Interweave
params.effect: How far each thread wanders from its row, in row spacings — neat parallel combing near 0, threads crossing and tousling over one another above 1.

params.label: Thread weight
params.effect: Thickness of each thread in CSS pixels, from hair-thin to a heavy luminous cord — soften separately with Blur.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: Speed of the drift and the light running along the threads — a frozen hank at 0, briskly streaming at full.

params.label: Curl
params.effect: Amount of fine high-frequency curl in each thread — smooth lazy waves at 0, a kinked frizzy hank at 1.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the halo bleeding off each thread — crisp threads at 0, a hazy bloom at 1.

params.label: Hue spread
params.effect: How far colour travels across the frame — a single tinted hank near 0, a full spectral field at the high end.

params.label: Blur
params.effect: Softness of the glow halo, independent of thread weight — a crisp drawn thread at 0, a soft luminous bloom at 1.

params.label: Lean
params.effect: Diagonal lean of the whole combed field, from level threads to a raked diagonal sweep.
